content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Mobile municipal and agricultural equipment makers, not precision bearings or engineered rotating components for aerospace and industrial OEMs."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Electric motors, drives and motion controls, a different product family from bearings and engineered mechanical components."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients and additives sold to formulators, unrelated to precision bearings and components."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Roofing, insulation and coatings products, with only brake components overlapping, not bearings for aerospace and industrial OEMs."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Architectural cladding, oilfield perforating systems and clad metal plates, a different business from precision bearings."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Brand owner selling replacement automotive and truck parts through aftermarket retailers, not manufacturing precision bearings for OEMs."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Distributor of electronic components and fasteners buying from manufacturers, not a bearing maker selling engineered components from its own plants."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, polymers and fibers sold to manufacturers, a materials business unlike precision mechanical bearings."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mainly pumps and valves, with friction and connector lines; product mix and customers differ from bearings for aerospace and industrial OEMs."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Chlor-alkali chemicals and Winchester ammunition sold to retail and government, unrelated to precision bearings."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, fiberglass insulation and glass reinforcements, primarily residential and commercial construction products."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Digital on-demand prototype and low-volume parts service for product developers, not bearings sold to OEMs and primes."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Structural connectors, anchors and fasteners for building construction, serving builders and dealers rather than aerospace and industrial OEMs."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hinges, security devices and metal castings, a hardware business rather than precision bearings for aerospace and defense."},{"label":"C15","good":true,"reason":"Designs and manufactures bearings for OEMs, aerospace and industrial customers, with aftermarket distributors, from its own plants."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Turf, landscaping and snow equipment sold to professionals and homeowners through dealers, not precision bearings for industrial OEMs."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Custom molded foam, plastic and composite parts for medical and defense OEMs, a different product technology than precision bearings."}]}
